dict.string: PopBar uses automation to read the browser's current URL for clipping, to create Calendar events, and to ask Finder to move protected leftover folders (such as app containers) to the Trash in Disk Cleanup.
PopBar adds an event to the "PopBar" calendar for each completed Pomodoro focus round when you turn this on.
PopBar records a camera picture-in-picture into screen recordings when you turn on the camera option.
PopBar scans your local network for TVs with ADB debugging enabled so TV Remote can find and control them.
PopBar records microphone audio into screen recordings when you turn on the microphone option.
PopBar keeps your Today to-dos in sync with the "PopBar" list in Reminders when you turn this on.
